name: Video Embed Field Plyr
description: Add Plyr.js as a field formatter for video embed or oEmbed fields
project_description: Adds two Drupal field formatters that render video fields through the bundled Plyr.js HTML5 player instead of the provider's default embed. PlyrEmbed targets the contrib video_embed_field field type; PlyrOembed targets link/string fields on core Media oEmbed sources. Both wrap YouTube and Vimeo videos (self-hosted MP4 is not implemented) in one consistent, themeable, keyboard-accessible player. Player options (autoplay, loop, control buttons, background mode, YouTube no-cookie, RangeTouch, IE11 polyfill) are configured per field instance per view mode; the output is rendered through overridable Twig templates. Plyr 3.7.8 and RangeTouch 2.0.1 are shipped inside the module (assets/plyr/) and served locally.
